owner_decision.statement: The Owner retained the no-migration 1.5.6 and migration-bearing 1.5.7 split on 2026-10-10 and subsequently directed proceeding until complete 1.5.7 final publication, superseding the earlier holds. Stable 1.5.6 is independently verified for all 44 fixed-group packages from main 6dabf052b2948fe0c2688cdb23c9d390c16af5ed, tree 9102e545c8c09b2ea4cf694cef1abea221a686e9, publication run 38028077567 and annotated unified v1.5.6 tag ed3dbc41d0b3a89b18f8f642efc5ddd77597a0df. Fresh authenticated census at 2026-10-10T05:58:39.542Z observed all 44 latest tags at 1.5.6, rc 1.5.0-rc.2 unchanged, 1.5.7 absent for all packages, matching published 1.5.6 integrities and the unchanged angular-profile 2.0.0 integrity; report SHA-256 9d35cc4c4a8719a5773ed72b8c3fff2b9072990567317de00889f39716fb2822. Exactly the outbox-configurable-app-role and offline-sync-1-5-7-pending-review-context changesets advance the fixed group to 1.5.7 under ADR-DEVAI-ADOPTION-0018 for UPS-OBX-10 and UPS-OFS-06/07/08. The 1.5.6 observation SC-20261010T050509-001 is RED and non-promoting; its real readings, proof chain and evidence remain preserved. Publish only with latest and an action-specific exact-main-SHA Owner receipt under the existing mandate, after ordinary gates and a fresh exact-main census. Preflight latest must remain 1.5.6 and rc must remain 1.5.0-rc.2 until publication. Stop at the first failed, partial or ambiguous publication; recovery requires fresh Owner authorization. This decision does not authorize angular-profile 2.0.0 remediation.

anomalies.rationale: The Owner adjudicated 2.0.0 as an incorrect major assignment rather than a canonical STYNX 2.x decision.
anomalies.closure_condition: Unified stable 1.5.7 is verified for all 44 publishable packages, latest resolves to 1.5.7, rc remains at 1.5.0-rc.2, and angular-profile 2.0.0 remains immutable non-canonical history.
